svg.title: Southern Spear Website Design and Implementation Specification
svg.desc: Polished desktop website reference containing an implementation brief, colour system, typography, spacing, components, supplied logo, supplied header artwork, responsive guidance, page navigation, game information, how to play, downloads, GitHub, community and donation sections.
svg.text: Build a highly legible, responsive informational website. Use the supplied logo and header artwork as canonical brand assets.
The design must feel Australian, tactical and contemporary without imitating official Defence branding.

g.text: Do not redraw, retype or substitute this artwork.
Headings: condensed, heavy sans-serif. Body: neutral system sans-serif. Never use script or stencil novelty fonts.
Desktop max-width 1280 px • 12 columns • 24 px gutters • 70 px page margins • 8 px base spacing unit.
Breakpoints: 1280, 1024, 768 and 480 px. Collapse navigation to a menu button below 900 px. Preserve 4:1 hero crop.
WCAG AA contrast • keyboard-visible focus • semantic headings • descriptive alt text • reduced-motion support.
Plain, factual language. No fabricated release version, file size, player count, date, testimonial or download link.

svg.text: The website mockup begins below. Annotation content above is implementation guidance and should not appear on the public site.

g.text: An Australian-inspired tactical shooter focused on disciplined teamwork,
qualifications, authentic roles and objective-based multiplayer.

svg.text: Southern Spear rewards communication, preparation and role discipline. Players experience their own team
as the Commonwealth Land Service while the opposing team is presented as the fictional Murasian Armed Forces.
Presentation changes appearance only. Gameplay tuning remains mechanically equal across both teams.

g.text: Complete core movement, weapon and role
training before taking responsibility in a match.
Team capability matters more than individual score.
complete the mission with the team intact.

svg.text: Also provide separate pages for controls, training, roles, server browser and troubleshooting.

g.text: Conventional infantry of the Commonwealth Land Service.
A fictional conventional opposing force using original

svg.text: Show the current milestone, verified features, known limitations and next objective. Populate these fields from
repository data where possible. Never display fabricated completion percentages or release dates.
Download the current build or review technical requirements first.
Version, file size, checksum and date must be populated from release metadata.
SOUTHERN SPEAR • FICTIONAL ENTERTAINMENT PRODUCT • NOT ENDORSED BY THE AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT OR DEFENCE ORGANISATIONS
